facts.value: Under the Student Service, students of the Department of Economics can receive support and advice on various questions regarding their studies.

The E! Week with its mentoring program is the ideal start for all Bachelor students. In a three-day program, first-semester students learn about Goethe University, the department, our campus life, and the city of Frankfurt.
Our Master students are warmly welcomed at the Master Welcome Day and receive important information.

The event series 'Bachelor meets Business' aims to create a forum for the exchange between science and practice. Each winter semester, an exciting selection of companies is invited. Master students are also welcome!

Our Dean's List aims to honor outstanding academic achievements and simultaneously bring students and companies together. This special recognition by the dean is awarded every semester to the best Bachelor and Master students.

An opportunity to get to know the student initiatives of our department is already provided during the first semester week (E! Week). Interested individuals can also find information on our website about the work, current projects, and engagement opportunities in the student initiatives and the Department of Economics.
All Bachelor and Master graduates receive an invitation to the graduation celebration, where the graduation is traditionally celebrated with gowns.
Please also note the dates of important information events and our Student News.
